## User Management API  [Print](https://support.authentic8.com/support/solutions/articles/16000102110-user-management-api\# "Print this Article")

Modified on: Mon, Feb 2, 2026 at 8:18 AM

* * *

Silo accounts can be managed programmatically via Authentic8's User Management API. Below are quick definitions of available commands, along with example requests and responses

The [Active Directory Sync (DirSync)](https://support.authentic8.com/support/solutions/articles/16000117214-active-directory-sync-tool) toolkit also utilizes the User Management API for account provisioning

**System Requirements**

● User Management API token (contact the Authentic8 Support team)

● Org Names — access to a list of Silo organization names for your environment

● Endpoint — all commands should be made by POST to [https://extapi.authentic8.com](https://extapi.authentic8.com/)

**API Commands**

1. ****listusers**— list all users in a specified organization**
2. ****adduser** — add a new Silo account**
3. ****deleteuser** — delete an existing Silo account**
4. **getuser** — review details about a specific user record
5. **modifyuser** — update Silo account information
6. **admin.user\_to\_admin**— upgrade a user account to an admin
7. **reset\_pin**— reset a user's PIN, creating a temporary password
8. **suspenduser** — suspend an existing Silo account to prevent access
9. **unsuspenduser**— restores the suspension account back to active


**1\. List Users**

**Required parameters**

● API token (setauth)

● Org name (org) — name of the target Silo organization

**Optional Data**

● Command ID — a string which will be echoed back with the response

**POST request example:**

* * *

\
    "data": "<api\_token>"\

\
    "command": "listusers",\
\
    "org": "Support Demo",\
\
    "command\_id": "Support Demo"\
\
}\
\
\]

**2\. Add Users**

**Required parameters**

● API token (setauth)

● Org name (org) — name of the target Silo organization

● User ID (username) — same as email address (recommended)

● Email (email) — same as username

**Optional Data**

● Command ID — a string which will be echoed back with the response

● First Name (given\_name) — first name

● Last Name (surname) — last name

● Mobile Number (phone) —  mobile phone number for receiving SMS verification codes

**Important:**

By providing your mobile number, you consent to receive 2FA text messages from us. Message and data rates may apply. Reply **STOP** to opt out or **HELP** for assistance. Message frequency may vary or be one-time. Carriers are not responsible for delayed or undelivered messages. For more details, please visit our [SMS Terms and Conditions](https://www.authentic8.com/sms-terms-and-conditions)

* * *

{ "command": "setauth", "data": "<api\_token>" },\
